title: Latency consistency trust signal contract (L47)
description: Per-agent p50/p99 latency ratio over rolling 24h. See ADR-036.

invariants.name: field_name_latency_consistency
invariants.description: Exact field name in TrustSignals. Type float, range [0.0, 1.0].

invariants.name: window_24h_sample_100
must: older samples filtered out before computation

invariants.name: p50_p99_formula
must: p99 == 0 (impossible at samples > 0) -> 1.0 by clamp convention

invariants.name: default_0_5_on_insufficient_data
must: no false-confident extreme on cold start

invariants.name: l51_contract_test_must_update
invariants.description: L51 fan-in contract test MUST include this field when added.
must: implementation PR amends L51 test together with TrustSignals dataclass

invariants.name: refresh_cache_1h
invariants.description: 1h refresh cadence (faster than stability_score 24h because latency drift is faster).
must: cached value reused for queries within the cadence window
